model_definition: unchanged SG-EXP-027 eventtime models; ten spaces, seven channels, hidden32, six TCN levels, two graph layers, full AGCRN NAPL+DAGG
tcn_width: argmin absolute parameter-count difference to MRG over integer widths 32..64; never fit to error

training.selection: tuning MAE in original proxy units

search_budget: zero extra hyperparameter search for every model; identical fixed-config budget, not universally optimal baseline comparison
primary_metric: pooled MAE over all common origin x horizon x node keys

statistics.seed_summary: mean and sample standard deviation ddof=1 across all three seeds
statistics.block: nonoverlapping seven-day UTC origin-time blocks with all seeds, nodes and horizons kept together
statistics.interval: paired difference baseline-MRG percentile95%; family of three primary pairs Bonferroni98.333333% intervals also reported
statistics.sensitivity: one-day blocks, descriptive; do not select the favorable interval
statistics.few_blocks: report descriptive differences and label inference insufficient, never relabel daily blocks as primary

calibration_secondary.rolling_policy: mature labels strictly before daily cutoff only; no retraining
calibration_secondary.quantile: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic; +infinity if rank exceeds n

winner_policy: overall superiority only if MRG has lower three-seed mean than both complete AGCRN and matched TCN on the primary metric and adjusted paired intervals exclude zero; otherwise identify the actual best method and any restricted benefit; never change primary scope after seeing results
test_gate: all configurations and best checkpoints locked before any test export; test evaluation once per seed; no test-driven retraining, seed selection, postprocessing or node replacement
execution_target: user-started cloud_autodl later; this task performs acquisition/QC/pre-registration only
prohibited: calling the legacy hardcoded FrozenData loader with JPL
editing the thesis or unique DOCX during feasibility work
